about_the_game:
This demo gives you a taste of the core multiplayer experience of Stickforge - have fun with a variety of items, play with physics, and test out creative combat setups solo or with others.

Key Features in the Demo:

  • Epic Multiplayer Battles with up to 24 players

  • Free-For-All and Conquer Points modes

  • Stickman combat with physics-based interactions

  • A selection of weapons and items to experiment with

Try it out with your friends!
